data.action: 夕阳下吃便当，清贫的平静
data.camera: medium shot, sitting on rooftop concrete steps eating bento
data.description: 【深森白夜 · 学校天台·夕阳便当与清贫侧影】放学后染满晚霞的学校天台铁丝网旁，生活清贫却格外坚韧的白夜静静坐在水泥阶梯上，慢慢吃着只有一个腌梅子和白米饭的单薄便当。看到你走过来，她有些窘迫却依然露出平静而温柔的浅笑——「虽然便当很简单……但吃饱了就有力气继续去打工和战斗了。」
data.promptProse: Byakuya sits on the school rooftop's concrete steps after class, slowly eating a simple rice-and-pickled-plum bento in her faded navy sailor uniform. Her worn schoolbag rests nearby as she looks up with a composed but slightly embarrassed smile. The medium view places the chain fence behind her and open sky beyond. Golden sunset lights the white scarf and rice, laying fence shadows across the empty step beside her.
data.title: 深森白夜 · 学校天台·夕阳便当与清贫侧影
